title: Grace makes the impossible possible
english: Some things are so great and so far beyond the human — so high above our perishable nature — that our rational and mortal race cannot grasp them. Yet by the rich and immeasurable [[grace of God poured out on people >> Bible:Titus 3:5-6]] through Jesus Christ, servant of his unsurpassable grace toward us, and through the co-working Spirit, by God’s will they become possible. So the possession of [[Wisdom, by which all things were made >> Bible:Psalm 104:24]] — impossible for human nature as such — becomes possible from the impossible through our Lord Jesus Christ, who [[became for us wisdom from God — righteousness and sanctification and redemption >> Bible:1 Corinthians 1:30]].

title: Why Ambrose and Tatiana asked for a treatise on prayer
english: But it is likely, most God-fearing and hardworking Ambrose, and most modest and brave Tatiana — from whom, I pray, womanly weakness has already withdrawn as it had from Sarah — that you wonder why a treatise on prayer begins with what is impossible for humans yet possible by grace. I am persuaded that to expound prayer worthily, as one ought and as one can, is among the impossible things that become possible by grace — [[not in words taught by human wisdom but taught by the Spirit >> Bible:1 Corinthians 2:13]]. Glory to Christ. Amen.
